creates_law_reviewed.class: VERIFICATION + A STRUCTURAL FINDING -- it verifies two cited dimension counts on specific manifolds and measures where the resulting room lives.
creates_law_reviewed.basis: The dimension counts are Thurston's and Menal-Ferrer--Porti's theorems; this arc verifies them at k=5, n=3, which B1406 had flagged as cited-and-unverified. The genuinely new content -- that H^1(M) -> H^1(boundary M) is injective, so the entire parameter room is cusp-local with zero interior moduli -- is a consequence of half-lives-half-dies plus the computed equality dim image = dim H^1(M), i.e. a measurement rather than a new proposition. It is banked as a finding, not a law.

claim_one_line: THE TOWER'S BUDGET IS REAL, IT IS EXACTLY 20 REAL PARAMETERS, AND EVERY ONE OF THEM IS BOUNDARY DATA. Prereg sealed 5618216a and pushed at 31cfd032 BEFORE any compute; zero anchors; no measured value anywhere. THE RESULT. At the tower's ceiling -- the chiral 5-cusped degree-10 cover L14n63694 (= otet20_00063, appearing as m004.covers(10)[17] and [32], which are ISOMETRIC, so there is ONE such manifold and not two) -- the character variety's dimension at the geometric representation is dim_C H^1(pi_1, sl_2) = 5 = k and dim_C H^1(pi_1, sl_3) = 10 = k(n-1), i.e. TWENTY REAL PARAMETERS. The budget is real: the first count in the corpus that clears the ~19 dimensionless parameters a Standard Model needs. Menal-Ferrer--Porti's k(n-1) -- CITED AND EXPLICITLY UNVERIFIED where B1406 section 3 leans on it -- is now VERIFIED in the one place the programme needs it. L217's tower row closes POSITIVE. AND THE PART THE PREREG DID NOT ANTICIPATE, BECAUSE IT WAS NOT ANTICIPATED: the restriction map H^1(M) -> H^1(boundary M) is INJECTIVE in every case, with dim H^1(boundary M) = 10 = 2 dim H^1(M) exactly -- half-lives-half-dies, so the image is Lagrangian and the map loses nothing. EVERY ONE OF THE 20 REAL PARAMETERS IS CUSP DATA; THERE ARE ZERO INTERIOR MODULI. The per-cusp figures are uniform, t0 = 1 and t1 = 2 at each of the five cusps, so the room is TWO COMPLEX NUMBERS AT EACH CUSP rather than a pooled ten. The room exists, it is big enough, and it is made entirely of the thing the programme already knows it cannot select. THE CONTROL THAT MATTERS, and it is stronger than the headline: a1 TRACKS k ACROSS THE WHOLE TOWER. Swept over every chiral multi-cusped degree-10 cover, selected BY PROPERTY (cusps >= 2 and not amphichiral) and never by list index -- k = 2 gives (2, 4), k = 3 gives (3, 6), k = 4 gives (4, 8), k = 5 gives (5, 10), with a0 = 0 and n = a1 - r1 = 0 on every row. So dim H^1 = k(n-1) EXACTLY IN BOTH PARAMETERS on this object's own covers -- Menal-Ferrer--Porti verified as a two-parameter law rather than a single coincidence, and the right control because the thing that could break (k) is the thing that varies (E67). AND THE INJECTIVITY HOLDS ON EVERY ROW: there are no interior moduli ANYWHERE in the tower, not just at its ceiling. A CLAIM IN THIS ARC'S OWN SEALED PREREG IS WRONG AND THE SEAL IS NOT EDITED TO HIDE IT: the prereg says 'No character variety has ever been computed on any cover', but analyse_exact RETURNS a1 in its output dict and B1333 called it on all 54 chiral multi-cusped covers across 38 070 sectors, these two among them -- the tangent dimension was computed tens of thousands of times and never printed, that arc having chased the index I = t0 - r1 and reported only (c, live, t0, I). The honest claim is not 'nobody has computed it' but 'IT HAS BEEN COMPUTED AND NEVER READ', which makes this a reporting-and-certification arc rather than a new computation and a much easier thing to defend. Two things survive as genuinely new: the EXACT characteristic-zero run at the Sym^2+Sym^4 germ (B1333's logged exact pass ran germ Sym^2 only and the (2,4) germ was run mod p, where rank mod p <= rank char 0 bounds and does not determine), and the injectivity reading, which no arc had drawn from numbers it already had. THE COMPUTATION. sl_2 = Sym^2 V and, under the principal SL(2) in SL(3), sl_3 = Sym^2 V + Sym^4 V (3 + 5 = 8), so the SL(3) budget is a sum of two H^1's with coefficients in symmetric powers of the geometric holonomy -- no Ptolemy variety needed, and none was tractable, since ptolemy_variety(3, obstruction_class='all') on this cover returns 122 varieties in 80 variables. Exact over Q(zeta_12) end to end, reusing B1333's exact_rho (PSLQ), fi_lib.sym and mcexact.analyse_exact, whose a1 = |Z^1| - (d - a0) IS dim H^1. No tolerance anywhere (E75). ALL FOUR KILL CONDITIONS CLEARED: the m004 positive control returns dim H^1 = 1 = k for both germs; the two isometric presentations agree exactly (5,10) vs (5,10); exact_rho recognised every holonomy with no float fallback; a0 = 0 everywhere, so every representation is irreducible. The amphichiral control otet20_00571 returns the IDENTICAL numbers, confirming the prereg's fence that the dimension is chirality-blind: room and chirality coexist on this manifold without interacting. WHAT IT LICENSES: the tower's room is real and sufficient in count, 20 real >= 19, so B1406's 'room is in the tower' survives its own best-case test; k(n-1) is verified rather than cited; the dimension is chirality-independent; L217's tower row closes with a number and a structure. WHAT IT DOES NOT LICENSE, AND THE PREREG SAID SO BEFORE THE NUMBERS EXISTED: a dimension is ROOM, NOT PARAMETERS, and nothing selects a point in it. The injectivity finding makes selection WORSE rather than better: since all ten are cusp-local, a selection is a choice of boundary data at each of five cusps, which is structurally the same unpriced free input as a Dehn slope -- the corpus has carried 'slope selection stays free input' (B432) since 2026, and B322 already tested filling invariants against SM parameters at CHANCE LEVEL (8/12 against a null of 7.6). R11 would charge for that selection and nothing here pays it. THE HONEST ONE-LINE READING: the programme has found where its parameters could live, and it is exactly the place it has never been able to select from. FENCES: no value compared to any measurement; LISTENER_MAP_SPEC F2 stands; B1333's index result is NOT contested, H^1 and the index being different quantities computed here with the same instrument; Thurston and Menal-Ferrer--Porti are cited, this arc verifying their counts on specific manifolds rather than reproving the theorems; the 5-cusp ceiling is B1305's, searched to degree 12, and nothing here claims anything about deeper covers. Nothing reaches CLAIMS.md, F2 or Gate 5.
